summary: This lecture is already the public definition spine for Nation As God-Machine: nationalism becomes a replacement god, absorbs rival ideologies, spreads as coordination pressure, and turns unity of will, population, welfare, and war into duties of a sacred body.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Nationalism absorbs liberalism and communism into one group struggling against other groups.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Nation page already uses this source as the stable anchor for nationalism as a god-machine that swallows rival ideologies rather than being displaced by them.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Four brothers can defeat ten strangers because cohesion, love, stake, and willingness to die matter more than numbers.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Nation page already carries this as the practical test for national strength: unity of will makes a smaller cohesive people stronger than a larger loose aggregate.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The French Revolution draws the people into war and creates an almost infinite supply of soldiers.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The lecture supplies the origin layer for the population-war anchor; later sources harden the same mechanism into population growth, welfare, industry, and whole-society war capacity.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The nation gives the isolated individual a community after money, reason, and the self fail to replace God.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links this beat to the atlas-level Nation concept. The impact pass closes accounting rather than creating a new replacement-God page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Once one group coordinates, every other loose population must group together or lose.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Game Theory page already uses the nation-state lecture to show how coordination changes the survival board for everyone else.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: No immediate append is needed. Keep this source as the core Nation definition layer: state plus imagined people, Protestant loneliness, bourgeois property security, anomie and disenchantment, ideology absorption, unity of will, French citizen armies, German church-like culture, and the later return of nationalism.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns the replacement-god body and its usable force. Power owns the broader conversion of symbols into reality; Legitimacy Fiction owns rules and titles that make rule rightful; Strategy owns material war tests once the national story becomes operational conflict.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep this source as evidence for coordination-over-mass: nationalism spreads because one coordinated group changes the game and forces other populations to coordinate or lose.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns the coordination form. Nation owns the sacred body and unity of will produced by that form.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as comparison pressure when religion's binding energy is transferred into secular political form. The active Nation mechanism is not administrative religion but nationalism as replacement God.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Religion As Administrative Filter owns religious attachment as civic and bureaucratic formation. Nation owns the moment political peoplehood becomes the new sacred body.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold anomie, alienation, disenchantment, standardization, print, mobility, and urbanization as background pressure for mass society only when the active mechanism is population-scale management or conformity.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns administration and conformity at population scale. Nation owns the emotional and sacrificial body created from that dislocation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use Rousseau's general will, French republican rights, and the Dreyfus Affair only where the question is why rights, citizenship, and republican promises make rule feel rightful.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy Fiction owns rightful-rule stories. Nation owns the sacred body that can use those stories to mobilize loyalty and sacrifice.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the French/German contrast as comparison pressure: French nationalism protects rights through the state, while German nationalism treats culture, language, and Geist as prior to the individual.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization owns inherited culture as inner order. Nation owns the modern political fusion that turns culture or rights into a mobilizing sacred body.

new_lens_seeds.title: French Rights Versus German Culture Nationalism
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: The same nation-state form can be justified through opposite sacred grammars: the French version makes the state protect free citizens and universal rights, while the German version makes the nation protect language, culture, blood, land, and spirit as prior to individuals.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The distinction clarifies later Jiang comparisons of America, Britain, France, Germany, Japan, fascism, Zionism, Christian nationalism, and the return of nationalism without making every case a generic nationalism topic.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as comparison pressure. The current Nation parent already explains the contrast compactly, and a child page would need several dated sources proving the distinction needs its own reader surface.

new_lens_seeds.title: Return Of Nationalism After Pax Americana
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A postwar order tries to replace national struggle with rules, rights, free trade, consumer happiness, and individual selfhood, but those substitutes fail to bind people as deeply as the nation; nationalism returns when the anti-national order no longer satisfies meaning, protection, or unity.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism connects the nation-state course ending to later American-game, Christian-nationalism, globalized-elite split, imperial-retreat, and city-state-after-nation-state material.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold under Nation for now. The public page already has replacement-unity and American-game sections that can receive this pressure in future compression, and the current source alone should not create a new Pax Americana or return-of-nationalism page.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-06-05, this Civilization #58 lecture is the main public origin layer for Nation As God-Machine, preceding later American-game, German-welfare, population-war, globalized-elite, Christian-nationalist, and city-state-successor extensions.

The lecture's ending states from June 2025 that nationalism is returning because Pax Americana's replacement package of rationalism, rights, trade, consumer happiness, and individual identity is not emotionally powerful enough.

This source distinguishes the French rights-state version from the German culture-church version, with Napoleon's humiliation of Germany and the Dreyfus Affair functioning as dated historical tests inside Jiang's model.

next_actions: Do not create standalone Nation-State, Nationalism, French Nationalism, German Nationalism, Fichte, Rousseau, Dreyfus Affair, Fascism, Mussolini, Futurism, Pax Americana, Return Of Nationalism, or Nation As New God pages from this source alone.

If public synthesis follows, keep Nation replacement/compression-first: the page already carries this source as its definition spine and should not receive another ordinary append unless new evidence forces a boundary change.

If provenance maintenance follows, batch by Nation concept: the episode read already links core marks to Nation and Game Theory anchors, but a future pass could add exact links for the return-of-nationalism ending only if a stable public anchor is created or revised.

Route Rousseau/general-will and rights promises to Legitimacy Fiction when rightful-rule stories are active; route print, standardization, anomie, and population-scale conformity to Mass Society only by active administration mechanism; route French/German cultural inheritance to Civilization when inner order, not national mobilization, is the main question.
